slot.brief: evaluate a determinant whose rows share terms, using row operations to pull out a common factor and split into simpler determinants

stem: The value of the determinant |1+a 1 1| |1 1+b 1| |1 1 1+c| is
working:
After R2 -> R2 - R1 and R3 -> R3 - R1, the determinant has rows (1+a,1,1), (-a,b,0), (-a,0,c). Expanding along the third row gives -a(0 - b) + c((1+a)b - (-a)) = ab + c(a + b + ab) = abc + ab + bc + ca.

Independent check: Expanding the determinant gives (1+a)(b+c+bc)-c-b=ab+bc+ca+abc.
solution:
Apply $R_2\to R_2-R_1$ and $R_3\to R_3-R_1$; the determinant becomes
$$\begin{vmatrix}1+a&1&1\\-a&b&0\\-a&0&c\end{vmatrix}=(1+a)bc+ac+ab=abc+ab+bc+ca.$$
